notes: Site is LIVE and trading (Havenly-owned; USD prices, IN_STOCK products returned). Apex interiordefine.com is A-only, but www.interiordefine.com is a CloudFront AAAA host so it was reached directly - no proxy needed. Storefront is a Magento PWA Studio SPA (empty #root, zero SSR HTML), so no rendered listing header exists; counts come from the site's own Magento GraphQL layer at /graphql, which is exactly what the PLP renders from. Full category tree crawled via categoryList: the catalogue is almost entirely custom furniture (Living 589, Dining 105, Bedroom 24, Office 36, Outdoor 14) plus Rugs 94 - all out of scope. Only two in-scope trees exist: Lighting (288) and part of Decor (289). Decor's other children are textiles and excluded: Pillows (21), Made to order pillows (12), Throws (0). Cross-check: Lighting children 9+6+1+0 = 16 = Lighting parent product_count exactly. Wall lights and Mirrors are genuine live categories that currently hold 0 products. Spot-checked item names to confirm scope: lamps under Lighting, framed artist prints (e.g. 'Ponder I by Coup D'esprit') under Artwork. All URLs confirmed via urlResolver returning type CATEGORY with the matching category id.
